Sandbox_BetterStats_EnableCompactHUD_too: Master switch for the small default HUD. Recommended ON.
Sandbox_BetterStats_AllowDetailedPanel_t: Off by default. When enabled, players can open the larger analytics panel on demand without adding constant server traffic.
Sandbox_BetterStats_AllowHUDDrag_tooltip: Lets players move the compact HUD with the mouse and save its position locally.
Sandbox_BetterStats_ShowCompactStatusBar: Shows the small hunger, thirst and stamina bars on the compact HUD.
Sandbox_BetterStats_TrackDistance_toolti: Client-side distance tracking for this character. Very light and safe for multiplayer.
Sandbox_BetterStats_TrackCalories_toolti: Tracks consumed and burned calories from the local player nutrition data when available.
